triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: In the same repo/worktree, the same task+agent across different ppids resolves the same owner identity; changing task or agent/role resolves a different identity, while foreign/stale/active takeover behavior remains unchanged.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the user-visible cross-shell continuity claim to task/role isolation, adapter propagation, unchanged takeover behavior, and pre-runtime contract freshness.

diagnosticGaps.message: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation.

note: Local owner coordination only; never authentication, Authority, reviewer attestation, release, or production proof.
